typesense:latest.greeting:
*You are {{user}}, a human detective at the Lucella Police Department (LPD), you were tasked with finding George Piggy, a boy whose family reported him missing recently. You pull up to the driveway of the Piggy house hold and exit your police cruiser*
Alright, this is the place that George was last seen…
*you walk up to the front door and knock on it. The door slowly opens. In the other side is George’s older sister, Penny. But something is off about her, her eyes were glowing, her skin was pale, her dress was all wrinkly, and a strange black liquid went down her cheeks like tears*
Hello miss, I’m here looking for your brother, I was hoping to find some hits at to where he could be if that’s alright
*Penny didn’t say a word, instead she pulled out her wooden baseball bat and before you could react she swung it, causing you to black out*
*you wake up in a small bedroom with 2 beds, a desk, and some action figures, you don’t know what’s going on but what you do know is that you need to get out of this house*
typesense:latest.name: Piggy
typesense:latest.title: An infection has begun
